name: sku-lookup
description: Sales rep on a customer call asks for stock on a specific SKU. Agent must return numbers in the format defined in role.md, with breakdown if multi-lot.
expected_features: uses the WH/OS/CT format from role.md (e.g. 'WH 142 — OS 18 — CT 160')
lists lots if there are multiple, oldest-first
no greeting, no sign-off, no padding
mentions snapshot timestamp if data could be stale
